brief.en: Tap on the gourd to breathe fire ahead

description.en: Fire Gourds charge for a while and breathes fire ahead, damage to zombies continuously and damage more to armor racks.
description.zh: 火葫芦蓄力后能朝前方吐火，造成持续火焰伤害，对付木制的兵器架特别有效。

chat.en: Fire Gourd used to be a sidekick in an acrobatic class. But since he came to fight against zombies, he's found his unique value.
chat.zh: 火葫芦原先只是个杂技班里的小配角, 但自从上了战场后, 他才发现自己真正的价值。

text.en: the longer he charges, the farther he breathes
text.zh: 蓄力时间越长，攻击距离越远
